scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The Connection Lab
scenes.caption: A fictional learner tells the Connection Lab teacher that an unusual message requested an account code. The teacher thanks the learner for speaking up. Tara helps prepare a minimal practice record containing the approximate time, communication channel and what action the message requested.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: What changed?
scenes.caption: The record distinguishes observed facts from unknowns. A displayed name is visible, but the sender’s real identity is not established by that name. If a secret was entered, the useful note describes its category without writing the actual password, code or recovery value into a shared worksheet.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.caption: The teacher uses the school’s established support process and keeps sensitive handling with responsible adults. The class does not promise a guaranteed recovery or accuse a person from incomplete evidence. Calm, prompt help makes a better response than public embarrassment, secrecy or a demand that the learner investigate alone.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Decide and explain
scenes.caption: The record needs to explain the kind of exposure without spreading the secret itself. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.speech: The record needs to explain the kind of exposure without spreading the secret itself. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.dialogue: What should a shared practice record say about an entered code?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Check the consequence
scenes.caption: Record that an account code was entered, without copying the actual value. A trusted adult handles the real incident through the approved process.
scenes.speech: Record that an account code was entered, without copying the actual value. A trusted adult handles the real incident through the approved process.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Investigate in the lab
scenes.caption: Investigate facts and unknowns, then minimum useful record, then support without blame. Test your plan, read feedback and try a changed case. Save evidence; explain one limitation.
